Sets the hard upper limit for adaptive keyframe spacing.
The encoder will never keep an inter chain alive longer than this value, even if it still compresses well.
Enter a whole number greater than 0.

Sets the main animation source that plays after the optional intro has finished.
Type or paste the path to a folder that contains the ordered PNG frames, or use the Browse button to pick the directory.
You can also drag a folder or ordered PNG files onto this screen.

Sets the maximum alpha-channel delta allowed for perceptual BIN_INTRA candidates.
Use lower values if transparency edges must stay very stable, or higher values if slightly softer alpha changes are acceptable.
Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Sets the maximum average perceptual error allowed for perceptual BIN_INTRA candidates.
Lower values keep the result closer to exact source pixels, while higher values allow stronger palette and shaping optimizations.
Enter a decimal value greater than or equal to 0.
Sets the maximum delay for the Aether's music manager to use if needing to reset the song delay outside the Aether
Sets the maximum scale factor to be used for the user interface. If 'auto' is used, then the largest scale factor will always be used.

Sets the maximum visible color-channel delta allowed for perceptual BIN_INTRA candidates.
Lower values are stricter and keep the result closer to pixel-exact output, while higher values allow more aggressive shrinking.
Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 0.

Sets the minimum byte savings that an inter continuation should still provide before the encoder prefers a refresh.
Higher values force keyframes sooner, while lower values let longer dependency chains survive.
Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 0.
Sets the minimum delay for the Aether's music manager to use if needing to reset the song delay outside the Aether

Sets the minimum relative savings ratio that an inter continuation should still provide.
This works together with the absolute byte threshold so large frames and small frames can be judged more fairly.
Enter a decimal value greater than or equal to 0.
